messages:
Leah Morgan: Hey @people-ops quick question — our baby arrived at 34w and is in the NICU. My paid leave was scheduled to end 2035-09-01 but discharge estimate is 2035-09-15. Do you offer NICU extensions or a small childcare subsidy for extra hospital visits? Also need to pause laptop auto-return and arrange oncall coverage.

Talia (People Ops): So sorry to hear that, congrats and sending support. :yellow_heart: We have a NICU extension workflow: upload the physician note to the secure form (select NICU) and sign PHI consent. Policy allows up to 6 weeks additional company top-up for documented NICU stays; payroll processes top-up next run after approval. We don't do recurring childcare stipends for hospital visits, but we do offer a one-time travel/parking reimbursement — file the travel expense with receipts and tag it NICU.

Leah Morgan: Uploaded note id nicu-2035-21 and signed consent. Discharge estimate 2035-09-15 (may move). I filed an expense for parking for yesterday (receipts attached).

HR Forms Bot: Received nicu-2035-21 and expense `exp-2035-998`. People Ops will review and attach to case PO-2035-21.

Maya (Payroll): FYI payroll cutoff: approvals before 2035-09-10 included in 2035-09-15 run; otherwise next. Travel reimbursements processed on expense cycles — allow 1-2 cycles. Top-up is taxable per normal payroll rules.

Nate (Eng Lead): Leah — team will cover things. I'll approve up to 4 weeks contractor time if needed. Suggest Mike covers weekday oncall; Sam can pick weekends. I'll post a 1-page handover.

Leah Morgan: Thanks Nate. Mike/Sam — can you confirm oncall swap?

Mike (SWE): I can take weekdays for the first 3 weeks.

Sam (SWE): I'll take weekends.

Talia (People Ops): Device hold placed for RDW-LM-78 until two weeks after return. Phased return options: 3 weeks 50% or 4 weeks 60%. Note: top-up applies while on approved leave only; ramp pay follows hours. If you want temporary partial pay during ramp, request an accommodation and we will review.

Leah Morgan: Id like 3 weeks at 50% for ramp. Also is there any lactation support for pumping at hospital visits?

Talia (People Ops): We can reserve a private room at the office for lactation and grant temporary badge access when you visit. For hospital pumping, we cannot coordinate directly with the hospital but will reimburse reasonable pump supplies under the expense policy.

Talia (People Ops): Action items: 1) approve provisional NICU top-up pending final review; 2) notify Payroll to queue top-up; 3) process travel expense exp-2035-998; 4) place device hold; 5) record phased return 3w@50%; 6) schedule 15-min sync tomorrow with Leah + Nate.

Leah Morgan: Thank you all  really appreciate the help and the quick response.
